sections.title: Your Project Map
sections.content: A balanced architecture prevents spaghetti code. Every file has a specific purpose, ensuring that as your project grows, it remains maintainable and easy to navigate.

examples.code:
project-root/
├── src/
│   ├── config/       # Database connection settings
│   ├── controllers/  # Business logic for each route
│   ├── middlewares/  # Request interceptors (e.g., upload.js)
│   ├── models/       # Data schemas and database logic
│   ├── routes/       # API endpoint definitions
│   └── index.js      # Application entry point
├── uploads/          # Storage for uploaded files (optional)
├── .env              # Environment variables
└── package.json      # Tool manifest
